risk_note: Gate tooling only (FU-EVIDENCE-CHECK-EARLY, D10-2341 / D10-2391). tools/ci/evidence-check.ts gains --early --pr <dir> --task <id> --base <ref> --spec <commit> [--json]: the shape half of the class 1 check at the rule-test stage - range merge-base(base, spec) -> spec, ledger at spec, the same block / support judgement as land (modifiedHitProblem's shape part extracted unchanged into declaredHitProblem, shared by both paths); no evidence file read, no owner-label lookup (a note instead), added files not judged, a removal or a rename judged by its source path. Exit 1 with a problem, 0 without, 2 on usage / unresolvable commit / unreadable ledger. The land path (without --early) is unchanged: its 63 existing unit tests pass and the money review r1 / r2 confirmed identical return values and problem texts. tools/ops/verify-container.sh --red runs it after red-check on the red run's own snapshot (a temporary commit object from git commit-tree when the snapshot differs from HEAD; no ref moves), writes red/<n>/evidence-shape.json and one log line; its stderr goes to evidence-shape.err; the red exit code stays red-check's; --dry-run shows evidence_shape. Two README sentences. No money, ledger or attribution code touched.
